selection_rule: Four frames/take: prefer Kinect stream with >=4 unused officially pallet-annotated frames, otherwise largest eligible stream; tie stream path. Sort timestamp within one stream, select floor(j*(N-1)/3),j0..3. No pixel/visibility/material/model screening. Abort duplicate decoded image rather than replace after pixels.

groups.fallback_reason: No Kinect stream in this take; largest eligible stream, lexicographic tie.

source_limitations: All six takes remain one official subset/environment/date; conservatively one source cluster for future folds.
New relative to listed review/training originals, not never exposed: V74 already inventoried all5593 source images.
Timestamp units are not verified across sensor streams. Temporal spacing is only within one selected stream.
Official pallet annotations are manual bbox-only (isbbox); no instance pixel mask or structural-cue gold is inferred.
Largest official bbox is solely a deterministic inspection crop, not an initializer target/cue association.
